title: Helium Stats
description: How Helium develops across versions: coverage, speed on the files versions share, and agreement with Silicon (helium_runs, silicon_runs).

list.name: suite
list.label: Suite
list.description: Only runs of these suites count.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT suite FROM helium_runs ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT suite FROM helium_runs ORDER BY 1

list.name: builds
list.label: Builds
list.description: Whether builds with uncommitted changes (dirty) count as versions of their own.
list.query: All builds : true, Clean commits only : false

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.description: What version-to-version comparisons measure; median over the iterations of a file. Comparisons with Silicon always use wall time.
list.query: Wall time (s) : wall_s, Helium self time (s) : self_s, Verify phase (s) : verify_s, Peak memory (MB) : peak_rss_mb

list.name: base
list.label: Base
list.description: Version to compare from; by default the one before Head.
list.query:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END AS version, min(started_at) AS first_run
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})) AND (${builds:raw} OR NOT coalesce(dirty, false)) AND status <> 'SKIPPED' AND backend_version IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT '__prev' AS __value, 'version before head' AS __text, NULL AS first_run
UNION ALL
SELECT version, to_char(first_run, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || left(version, 12) || CASE WHEN version LIKE '%+dirty' THEN ' (dirty)' ELSE '' END, first_run FROM h
ORDER BY first_run DESC NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Versions

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT backend_version || CASE WHEN coalesce(dirty, false) THEN '+dirty' ELSE '' END AS version,
         vpr_sha256,
         min(started_at) AS first_run,
         min(suite || '/' || coalesce(family || '/', '') || test) AS file,
         max(status) AS status,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ${metric:raw}) AS t,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_s) AS wall
  FROM helium_runs
  WHERE ('__all' IN (${suite:sqlstring}) OR suite IN (${suite:sqlstring})) AND (${builds:raw} OR NOT coalesce(dirty, false))
    AND status <> 'SKIPPED' AND backend_version IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
v AS (
  SELECT version, min(first_run) AS first_run, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY min(first_run)) AS i,
         to_char(min(first_run), 'MM-DD') || ' ' || left(version, 8)
           || CASE WHEN version LIKE '%+dirty' THEN ' dirty' ELSE '' END AS label
  FROM h GROUP BY 1
),
s AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (vpr_sha256) vpr_sha256, status, wall FROM (
    SELECT run_id, vpr_sha256, max(started_at) AS started, max(status) AS status,
           percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_s) AS wall
    FROM silicon_runs WHERE status <> 'SKIPPED' GROUP BY 1, 2) r
  -- latest verdict; files Silicon never decided keep their latest outcome instead
  ORDER BY vpr_sha256, status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') DESC, started DESC
),
c AS (
  SELECT h.*, v.i, v.label, s.status AS s_status, s.wall AS s_wall,
         h.status IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') AS decided,
         CASE WHEN h.status NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'FAILED') THEN 'undecided'
              WHEN s.status IS NULL THEN 'silicon not run'
              WHEN s.status = 'TIMED_OUT' THEN 'silicon timed out'
              WHEN s.status = 'CRASHED' THEN 'silicon crashed'
              WHEN s.status = 'INCONCLUSIVE' THEN 'silicon inconclusive'
              WHEN h.status = s.status THEN 'agree'
              WHEN h.status = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'unsound'
              ELSE 'incomplete' END AS class
  FROM h JOIN v USING (version) LEFT JOIN s USING (vpr_sha256)
),
link AS (
  -- each version against the one before it, on the files both decided
  SELECT cur.version, count(*) AS common, exp(avg(ln(prev.t / cur.t))) AS speedup,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE cur.class = 'unsound' AND prev.class <> 'unsound') AS new_unsound,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE cur.class <> 'unsound' AND prev.class = 'unsound') AS fixed_unsound,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE cur.class = 'incomplete' AND prev.class <> 'incomplete') AS new_incomplete,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE cur.class <> 'incomplete' AND prev.class = 'incomplete') AS fixed_incomplete
  FROM c cur JOIN c prev ON prev.vpr_sha256 = cur.vpr_sha256 AND prev.i = cur.i - 1
  WHERE cur.decided AND prev.decided AND cur.t > 0 AND prev.t > 0
  GROUP BY 1
),
per AS (
  SELECT version, i, label,
         count(*) AS files,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'VERIFIED') AS verified,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'INCONCLUSIVE') AS inconclusive,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CRASHED') AS crashed,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'TIMED_OUT') AS timed_out,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE decided) AS decided,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE class IN ('agree', 'unsound', 'incomplete')) AS judged,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE class = 'unsound') AS unsound,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE class = 'incomplete') AS incomplete,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE class = 'agree' AND wall > 0 AND s_wall > 0) AS agree,
         exp(avg(ln(s_wall / wall)) FILTER (WHERE class = 'agree' AND wall > 0 AND s_wall > 0)) AS vs_silicon
  FROM c GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT label AS "Version", files AS "Files", verified AS "Verified", failed AS "Failed",
       inconclusive AS "Inconclusive", crashed AS "Crashed", timed_out AS "Timed out",
       decided::float8 / nullif(files, 0) AS "Decided",
       link.common AS "Common with previous", link.speedup AS "× vs previous",
       exp(sum(ln(coalesce(link.speedup, 1))) OVER (ORDER BY i)) AS "× vs first (chained)",
       judged AS "Judged by Silicon",
       unsound AS "Unsound", '+' || coalesce(link.new_unsound, 0) || ' / −' || coalesce(link.fixed_unsound, 0) AS "Unsound new / fixed",
       incomplete AS "Incomplete", '+' || coalesce(link.new_incomplete, 0) || ' / −' || coalesce(link.fixed_incomplete, 0) AS "Incomplete new / fixed",
       vs_silicon AS "× vs Silicon", agree AS "Agreeing files"
FROM per LEFT JOIN link USING (version)
ORDER BY i DESC

panels.description: One row per Helium version, newest first. Files are identified by content (vpr_sha256), so an edited benchmark counts as a new file. A file counts as decided when Helium returned VERIFIED or FAILED. Speedups are geometric means of per-file ratios (old ÷ new), only over files both versions decided, so files a version newly handles do not make it look slower. > 1 means less ${metric:text}. The chained factor multiplies the factors against the previous version, so every link is measured on the files those two versions share. Silicon's verdict per file is its most recent VERIFIED/FAILED run of that file, from any suite. Unsound: Helium VERIFIED where Silicon FAILED. Incomplete: Helium FAILED where Silicon VERIFIED. New / fixed count files whose class changed against the previous version, on the files both decided. × vs Silicon: geometric mean of Silicon wall time ÷ Helium wall time on the files where they agree.

panels.title: Against Silicon
panels.description: Silicon's verdict per file is its most recent VERIFIED/FAILED run of that file, from any suite. Unsound: Helium VERIFIED where Silicon FAILED. Incomplete: Helium FAILED where Silicon VERIFIED.

panels.title: Agreement with Silicon per version
panels.description: Files per class. Silicon's verdict per file is its most recent VERIFIED/FAILED run of that file, from any suite. Unsound: Helium VERIFIED where Silicon FAILED. common AS (
